description: Utility class providing image resize functions, such as resizing images with or without maintaining aspect ratios, for use within the software project.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to resize BufferedImage objects using various techniques, including simple resize, resize with rendering hints, and aspect ratio preservation.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs a simple resize of an image without maintaining aspect ratio; takes a BufferedImage and target width and height.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image with a specified rendering hint and an option for higher quality resizing through multi-step scaling.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image while maintaining the aspect ratio based on target width and height, with logic to handle zero dimensions and aspect ratio calculations.
